description:
The list of detected apps associated with a device.

TIP: Lists all applications detected on Intune-managed devices. Each has displayName, version, sizeInByte, deviceCount, and platform. Use to audit software inventory and find unauthorized applications. Use $orderby=deviceCount desc to see most-installed apps.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-detected-apps
